caption: The drawing depicts a hand-operated mechanical device composed mainly of wood and a cylindrical glass or transparent container. The structure features a round wooden base supporting four vertical wooden columns. These columns extend upwards to hold two horizontal wooden plates, one at the top and one just above the glass container. The cylindrical container is transparent with a slight blue-green tint, allowing internal components to be visible. Inside, there is a vertical central rod with two horizontal metal bars fixed to it, both containing circular holes. On the exterior top part of the device is a large, toothed wooden wheel connected to a crank handle, which is attached perpendicularly, extending outward for manual operation. A smaller handle is fixed to the central shaft just below the wheel. The entire device is rendered in shades of light brown for the wood, metallic golds for the internal bars, and cool blue-greens for the glass container. The drawing is executed with fine lines and shading, with realistic texture and proportions. The background is a plain light beige.
title: Butter Churn
